text.3769bd592bcd8613f638: Load the complete reviewed annual schedule, source-dated equity-bridge options, timing policy and company-specific simulation settings together when “Use research” is selected. The annual schedule is the executable source of truth. Preserve existing user work until that explicit action, and provide a full undo.
text.4f3380613c9b61a72712: All 14 companies have complete defaults. The original 160 annual rows and terminal assumptions are unchanged. This is a source-linked analytical scenario set, not issuer forecasts, a complete survey of management commentary, consensus, a stock-price target, or empirically calibrated probabilities.
text.453fa21d381a65724191: Why the default needs annual-backed mode
text.a1577651a7508a6dccba: The guided schema-v2 controls correctly separate revenue, margin and capital timelines, but still impose linear margin transitions and scalar sales/capital rules. They cannot faithfully reproduce every reviewed annual schedule. Micron must invest in fabs during revenue contractions; AAOI and Nebius have forecast anchors and first-year growth above the scalar ceiling; tax normalization and direct-capital timing differ by company. No case is forced into an approximate scalar S:C merely to fit the interface.
text.402898c441fab954a0ef: Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet and TSMC retain their existing 15-year reviewed paths. The other ten retain ten years. No 20-year default is justified by this evidence. A long-lived building, backlog, leadership reputation or durable brand does not establish equally long above-market revenue growth.
text.4e6f584b08568d491505: These are descriptive timelines, not a claim that a company or its physical assets stop changing then. MU ends explicit growth at 2.5% and enters 2.0% terminal growth, so there is no falsely asserted identical endpoint. NVDA and AVGO retain disclosed capital-intensity steps at terminal value.
text.fd33182bd84f3d2e5037: Damodaran chooses distributions separately for the driver. His
text.72667dc6249eebe3e689: used lognormal growth, triangular margin and an Apple-specific +0.50 growth–margin correlation. The growth prose includes negative outcomes, so a transformed or shifted construction would be needed to reproduce it; a standard positive lognormal is not enough.
text.808c3a9789b7ca169512: illustrates uniform growth, normal margin, lognormal sales/capital and triangular WACC in one model. There is no universal “Damodaran distribution.” His
text.f53a40dbe2bb9829b489: emphasizes credible input distributions, dependency and risk-adjusted discount rates.
text.03d03e400599c3645041: These presets use bounded triangular distributions where the evidence supports a downside/base/upside scenario judgment, and Fixed where the current compressed model cannot express the uncertainty coherently. The selection is economic, not a claim that triangular is always best. No defensible Gaussian standard deviation or net-investment lognormal tail has been estimated here. Uniform would incorrectly imply equal plausibility throughout a range with a specifically reviewed central case. A component-level positive gross-cost model could use lognormal later if its transform and dispersion were justified.
text.9c0d98b9dc57302cca0d: All additive values in this table are percentage points. Triangular entries are low / mode / high. The investment factor is a multiple. The machine-readable JSON uses decimal rates: 0.01 means one percentage point.
text.d4fbb7135efb9ed05f1b: 5,000 attempted trials; deterministic ticker-specific seed; 36 histogram bins. Those are reproducibility/display choices, not forecast-precision claims.
text.b5f1e29f596f74d50fa5: One driver vector generates a full annual path. Growth shocks fade to zero in the final explicit year; they are not independently redrawn each year. Margin and WACC shifts persist across the explicit and terminal periods.
text.457c679ce011e09f3dac: The base is the neutral mode, not the simulation mean or median. Asymmetric triangular distributions have different means, and nonlinear valuation adds another difference.
text.265eca7ec83ed36eed1a: Independent draws are a disclosed simplifying assumption. No source-calibrated correlation matrix was available. Economic demand, utilization, margins, capital and financing co-move; joint-tail risk is therefore incomplete. Damodaran’s Apple +0.50 is not copied to other companies.
text.a7f4bbbe7d95205fbaeb: Validity constraints are enforced without clipping or replacement. Negative EV and equity remain signed. Terminal tax, growth, ROIC, dates and claim choices stay conditional fixed inputs.
text.f0fe085acb8eb2d730ff: Source S:C ratios inform some positive investment-factor bounds. Under the implemented revenue-scaled policy, investment preserves source investment/revenue intensity, not the exact incremental delta-revenue/S:C identity after a growth shock. The factors are finite-horizon capital-intensity sensitivities, not reconstructed capex budgets.
text.4830fad77f4f4967aec4: Fixed capital factors mean the engine does not encode annual capex-path uncertainty. They do not mean capex is certain. Named capital scenarios remain available in the bundle with provenance; their timing must not be replaced by a uniform multiplier.
text.bb0b6fe745d1372d79aa: Nebius also keeps the growth premium fixed at zero. The selected advance balances and runoff must move with customer revenue and capacity in a component-aware model. Free growth draws would break the 25%-of-sales advance policy. Its margin/WACC distribution is explicitly conditional on the selected operating/capital/advance path.
text.a14b382ff6e370761d38: A four-driver overlay is not a complete uncertainty model. It omits explicit default/recovery, funding availability, future dilution, terminal growth/ROIC uncertainty, taxes, discontinuous autonomy outcomes, geopolitics and claim-realization risk. Frequencies are model-implied scenario frequencies, not real-world probabilities.
text.f498082e386eea00d582: Persistent margin ranges were checked against early operating economics
text.cd978c1a54dba9fe4f79: Full bear/bull terminal margins were not automatically applied to every early year. For NVIDIA, a +8-point shift would imply 70% first-year EBIT margin despite cited 72–73% gross-margin outlook. In the

text.6f6bfdd4fddb45e071cb: Retain the reviewed 15-year gradual growth fade, with 18%, 17% and 15% in the first three years and 2.5% in year 15. AWS cloud/AI adoption, advertising and retail distribution provide distinct expansion opportunities, while sustained investment must earn its cost. The April 9 shareholder letter describes 6–24 months from capex to billing and capacity expansion through 2027; the June filing reports a 6.4-year weighted AWS backlog life. Those support near- and intermediate-term deployment, not a 15-year contracted forecast. The selected case already reaches $2.527 trillion of revenue and 7.708% growth in year 10, then $3.160 trillion in year 15, 4.074 times the anchor. This is a demanding but explicit analyst judgment. Keep the first ten reviewed years, margin maturity at year 7 and the direct capital schedule unchanged. A separately rebuilt 10-year normalization case is a credible more conservative alternative; 20 years remains an outer sensitivity, not the default. This is not Damodaran’s preferred horizon or a management forecast.

text.5ae1f6fbe396cecb09e4: calls for a check on scale, growth and competitive advantage, and his
text.9bdeec74c041ef4c0c80: cautions against pushing high-growth periods beyond ten years. The 15-year choice is our disclosed slower-fade exception.

text.2c0a5267618ee4f752eb: 53/55/54% early GAAP EBIT fades to 45% by year 10. Software mix and amortization runoff can support margin, but no assumption removes ongoing SBC, replacement IP or future acquisition costs.
text.ec3603f487da57411546: Capital maturity is unresolved: S:C remains 2 at final explicit year, then terminal 20% ROIC requires more reinvestment. Retain the source -7.168% terminal FCFF step and cash/lease/contingent-credit gates, rather than pretending a mature ratio bridge exists.
text.61bf6600f99048b01188: Tax: 20% normalized operating tax is above near-term ~16% adjusted guidance; FY 2025 discrete negative GAAP tax does not establish a sustainable rate.
text.6a5cbd676159c2857709: Discount rate: Bounds -1/+2 pp recover the explicit 10/13% stress range around 11%. Concentration, contingent finance and cyclicality justify the risk judgment; common Treasury 5.09% is measured, ERP 4.5% chosen, issuer beta/spread unmeasured.
text.8793a8c22b898f6a740c: Terminal policy: 2.5% nominal perpetual growth and 20% ROIC assume durable custom-silicon/networking/software rents but require 12.5% terminal NOPAT reinvestment. Acquisition-distorted book capital and a CEO record are not direct ROIC evidence.
text.d5736ea5b27353f5448b: Five years cover N 2/A 14 and current overseas construction; ten additional years span several node generations while growth fades to 2% in year 15. Preserve existing selected horizon; no automated 20-year extension.
text.95836b89beafff7cbab4: Margin reaches 46% in year 11 and stays there through year 15, earlier than growth maturity. Overseas dilution is already embedded; do not deduct the management 3–4 pp outlook again.
text.44a51814ab78dbc0001f: Early marginal S:C 1.30/1.25/1.20/1.15/1.10 fades to ~0.489 by year 15. Implied capex/D&A are an audit, not extra FCFF deductions; mature gross capex remains ~TWD 4.323 tr versus D&A 3.616 tr. In a full contraction stress preserve the source 8%-of-revenue positive investment floor. Preserve the neutral 1.751% terminal FCFF step.
text.b752727c71b6c260578d: Tax: 18%/19%/20% first-three-year operating cash tax then 20% is a selected normalization schedule, not a perpetual extrapolation of the latest effective rate. Grants are embedded once in capital economics.
text.f07a32d513bdab30be8e: Discount rate: Bounds -1.5/+3 pp recover native TWD source 8.5/13% around 10%. Source base USD build 11.3182% translates using assumed USD/TWD inflation 2.5/1.5% to TWD 10.2322%, rounded to 10%. Beta 1.2, 10% debt, 1.5% spread/extra equity risk are judgments. It is not a directly observed TWD sovereign yield.
text.0ad1438d2c73921e3f27: Terminal policy: 2% nominal TWD perpetual growth is currency-specific, consistent with assumed long-run TWD inflation 1.5% and modest real growth; not a USD guidance transcription. 18% ROIC supports a durable but fading foundry moat and requires 11.111% terminal NOPAT reinvestment.
